item.title: Elevator Pitch
item.description:
Hello There!

I am a strong willed individual who has come from a very different background than where I am today. I am positive I will find every and any way to get a problem solved, forever learning in this life. Working with me no question will go unanswered, and no one left in the dark when it comes to information. I do my best to bring as much positivity to life as I possibly can while keeping a professional appearance. If you want more smiles in your life while the job still gets done, let’s work together!
